summary:
洛克希德馬丁上一季 EPS 低於預期2.7%，營收20.32億美元，計畫認列仍承壓。
• EPS 5.80 美元，低於預估5.96（-2.71%）。
• 營收20.32億美元（B級），季節性規模較高。
• 訂單背書維持高檔，長期需求結構穩固。
• 本益比25.90，估值中性。
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：連續兩季 EPS 不及預期，反映固定價格合約損失與計畫認列拖累，獲利品質受質疑。短期股價缺乏催化，中期仍倚賴訂單背書與國防支出上升的長線邏輯。追蹤指標：合約損失提列趨勢、book-to-bill、營業利潤率與自由現金流。25.9倍本益比下，市場對連續 miss 容忍度下降，需見利潤率止穩訊號。

需留意：計畫減值與成本超支持續壓抑獲利。；營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢待確認。；預算與撥款政治不確定性。

summary_en:
Lockheed Martin missed EPS by 2.7% with $20.32B revenue, as program charges weighed.
• EPS of $5.80 missed the $5.96 estimate by 2.71%.
• Revenue of $20.32B reflected a seasonally larger scale.
• Backlog remains high, anchoring long-term demand.
• P/E of 25.90 is neutral.

ai_view_en:
Signal is soft: two consecutive EPS misses reflect fixed-price contract losses and program recognition drags, raising earnings-quality questions. Near-term the stock lacks catalysts; mid-term it relies on backlog and the secular rise in defense spending. Track charge trends, book-to-bill, operating margin, and free cash flow. At a 25.9x P/E, tolerance for repeated misses is falling, so a margin-stabilization signal is needed.

Watch：Program charges and cost overruns continue to pressure earnings.; Revenue YoY was not provided, leaving the trend unconfirmed.; Budget and appropriations political uncertainty persists.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估低2.71%，連續不及市場共識。
